title: Estimate Templates by Trade: Form, PDF, Word, Excel
description: Pick an estimate template with a working form for your trade. Each page has scope, exclusions, valid-until date, deposit, US price ranges and sources.
lede_html: Choose a trade to price a job before you start. Each page adds scope, exclusions, a valid-until date and a deposit to the form.

rows.html: A remodel or building job, with allowances and stages.
A roof priced by squares, with tear-off and a decking allowance.
Rooms or square feet, coats, prep and lead-safe notes.
Sod, mulch, patios, or a mowing season.
A recurring plan for a home or office, or a first deep clean.
Rough-ins and fixture swaps, with hidden pipe terms.
Panels, EV chargers and new circuits, with a load calculation.

body_html:
US rules that apply to each page

Words such as estimate, quote and bid have no single legal meaning across the US. What binds you depends on the wording and the state. How much over an estimate can a contractor go shows two state examples.

How to choose

Start from the trade closest to the job, because its sample lines, exclusions and rules are already filled in. When the customer says yes, the invoice pages take the same lines. Estimate vs invoice explains when to send each paper.
